---
name: Roadmap / planning epic
about: Define a coherent product or engineering direction and its acceptance gates
title: "[Roadmap] "
labels: "enhancement"
assignees: ""
---

## Goal

Describe the outcome and target users.

## Decision state

Proposed / accepted / deferred. Record explicit constraints and who decides.

## Scope and phases

- [ ] Milestone or phase 1
- [ ] Milestone or phase 2

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable correctness, content parity, UX, accessibility and release gates as appropriate

## Dependencies and conflicts

Existing issues/PRs, implementation order and known overlaps; indicate superseded work only after replacements pass.

## Boundaries / non-goals

Architecture, deployment, privacy/security, compatibility and rollout constraints.

## Validation and rollout

CI checks, preview, migration safety and rollback if relevant.

Implementation belongs in cohesive, linked tasks/PRs, not an unchecked mega-PR.
